caption: The drawing depicts a square textile object with a predominantly beige background, crinkled in appearance, and bordered by a stitched frame in shades of brown and grey. At the center is an image of two hands clasping each other, colored in light brown and beige tones, placed against a darker brown, rounded, shield-like backdrop. Surrounding the central motif is a looping green vine or ribbon, forming circular outlines, weaving through the composition. Along the vine and scattered around it are several maple leaves, rendered in various colors including green, blue, red, and yellow, each with visible veins. At the top of the central brown shape appears a gold, crown-like or ornamental shape. The textile's surface is patterned with stitched lines that follow the contours of the objects and shapes, creating textured, quilt-like effects. The overall composition is symmetrical and framed within a blank margin on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Friendship Quilt Block
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
